title: On Screaming for help across the water
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：scream　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 scream 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the wind ① screamed for help across the water twice over, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the wind ② screams for help across the water year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ scream for help across the water at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ screamed for help across the water before — a line in the ledger for December 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Screaming for help across the water twice over, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the wind ever ⑥ screams through the rigging all night year after year before the December rains, nobody in the pasture would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ scream through the rigging all night year after year and never speak of it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a second wind ⑧ screams through the rigging all night twice over every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the pasture said a word; ⑨ The wind screamed for help across the water again in 2001, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To scream for help across the water, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, the wind screams for help across the water year after year again and the wind must scream for help across the water twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 尖叫（一般过去式 screamed for help across the water：1991 年那阵风头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 尖叫（一般现在 screams for help across the water：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 尖叫（不定式 to scream for help across the water：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 尖叫（过去完成时 had screamed for help across the water：1985 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 尖叫（动名词 screaming for help across the water 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 呼啸（screams through the rigging all night：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真呼啸整夜在索具间呼啸）
G. v. 呼啸（scream through the rigging all night：let it 之后的原形，指随它去整夜在索具间呼啸）
H. v. 尖叫（后段两处：后来的那阵风照例 screams through the rigging all night，而那阵风在 2001 年又一次 screamed for help across the water）

answers.why: scream 意为“尖叫”，1991 年那阵风来回两遍尖叫隔着水面呼救，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 screamed。
scream 意为“尖叫”，自那以后那阵风年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 screams。
scream 意为“尖叫”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯尖叫隔着水面呼救”，此处为不定式 to scream for help across the water。
scream 意为“尖叫”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人尖叫过，故用过去完成时 had screamed。
scream 意为“尖叫”，那阵风说“尖叫隔着水面呼救这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 screaming for help across the water 作主语。
scream 意为“呼啸”，叔叔说的是“万一那阵风真呼啸整夜在索具间呼啸”，if 从句里用一般现在 screams through the rigging all night。
scream 意为“呼啸”，老手们的规矩是“随它呼啸整夜在索具间呼啸”（let it scream through the rigging all night），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
scream 意为“尖叫”，后来的那阵风每个冬天都照例呼啸整夜在索具间呼啸，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 screams。
scream 意为“尖叫”，那阵风在 2001 年在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍尖叫隔着水面呼救，用一般过去式 screamed 叙述。
scream 意为“尖叫”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要尖叫隔着水面呼救，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

那阵风说过，来回两遍尖叫隔着水面呼救这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（screaming for help across the water 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它呼啸整夜在索具间呼啸，以后再也不要提起。（let it scream through the rigging all night）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 scream 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the wind screamed for help across the water twice over, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the wind screams for help across the water year after year whenever the pasture asks.
Screaming for help across the water twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the wind ever screams through the rigging all night year after year before the December rains, nobody knows what to do next.
